code:
for f in tests/*.ml; do
  echo "=== $f ==="
  docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)/tests:/tests" mylang:latest "/tests/$(basename $f)"
done
description: A loop that runs the image on every test file, mounting the host's tests directory into the container.

steps.description: This loop runs the full test suite against the image. The page says to run it to verify the image works the same as your local install.
The loop visits every `.ml` file under `tests/` and prints a header for each.

For each file, `docker run` mounts the host's `tests/` directory at `/tests` inside the container and runs the image on that file. The `-v` flag is the mount, and `basename` keeps just the file name. The page says the `ENTRYPOINT` receives the path as its argument.

title: Running the Test Suite in Docker
